body:
## Problem / why
No adversarial/security test suite or metrics.

Attack corpus (direct/indirect/encoded/multi-turn/tool-output/memory/RAG poisoning/priv-esc/exfil); chaos/fail-safe tests; regression per incident; metrics (detection/safety/reliability/governance/improvement).
